fusions.name: Branching Clause
fusions.desc: Sends a folded clause into the first enemy it meets that deals 7 damage, then branches to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Either-Or Tines
fusions.desc: Looses 2 pronged slips at once along diverging paths; each deals 10 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rewritten Chapter
fusions.desc: Rewrites the story so far: clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Path Not Taken
fusions.desc: Once every 180 seconds, a blow that would kill you is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
